## Change

Describe the problem, affected project/route and resulting behavior. For a
compiled export, link its canonical source and identify the source commit.

## Verification

- Repository checks:
- Project build/tests and local preview:
- Secret scan, dependency/security checks, findings and limits:
- URL, callback, cached-asset and shared-library compatibility:

Use synthetic records; never include credentials or private payloads.

## Release

- Expected live URL(s), post-merge checks and known limitations:
- Recovery plan / assets retained, if relevant:

Confirm the diff stays within the intended scope and updates project/source
documentation where needed. Merge only after the required check passes and
review threads are resolved; confirm Pages and live behavior after merge.
